font_rules.headings: Use 'Unbounded' or 'Bebas Neue' with uppercase tracking-wider (0.05em to 0.15em) and neon text-shadow drop glows.
font_rules.body: Use 'Chivo' or system sans for maximum readability in status cards and equipment panels.
font_rules.hud_and_stats: Use 'JetBrains Mono' or monospace font for resource counters (GOLD, FOOD, STONE, CASTLE HP, MORALE) and cooldown timers to avoid layout shifts.

hierarchy.h1_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-wider uppercase text-cyan-400 drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(0,243,255,0.8)]
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wide text-fuchsia-400 drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(255,0,127,0.6)]

hud_styling.corner_brackets: Bracket-cornered clips using CSS border-corners or SVG pseudo-elements for sci-fi/arcade look
hud_styling.barricades: 45deg diagonal hazard stripes (#FFE600 and #12131A) with neon yellow glow border
hud_styling.tower_slots: Bracket-cornered squares with 1px cyan/yellow neon glow holding icon (gear, axe, bow, radiant sun)

grids_and_layouts.battlefield_viewport: Portrait-oriented mobile/desktop vertical battlefield (e.g. aspect-[9/16] or max-w-md / max-w-lg centered), dark grey field (#12131A), bounded by glowing yellow outer walls (#FFE600) and hot-red inner gate line (#FF2A5F). Enemies spawn at TOP and move DOWN toward 4 heroes at BOTTOM.
grids_and_layouts.bento_config_panels: Hero & Tower side/drawer panels split into 2-column grid: Left = Equipment slots (Helm, Armor, Weapon, Cloak, Ring), Right = Core Stats (HP, ATK, DEF, AGL, INT) + Attack Config.
grids_and_layouts.bottom_hud_layout: Horizontal bar fixed at bottom with 4 key metrics: Gold+Workers, Food+Farmers, Stone, Morale Bar, and Castle HP.

motion.tactical_battle_clock: When Hero/Tower profile modal or drawer opens during active wave, game simulation clock visibly slows down to 0.2x speed (tactical slowdown) with visual scanline motion effect.

micro_interactions.hover: Slight scale-105 with increased neon glow brightness
micro_interactions.active_press: scale-95 push down with flash white highlight
micro_interactions.tower_fire: Pulse ring expanding outward + recoil displacement (2px)
micro_interactions.enemy_hit: Flash red/white silhouette + small floating damage numbers
micro_interactions.scout_countdown: Large pulse numbers 5..4..3..2..1 with sound wave glow ring

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_rule: All text must maintain APCA / WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast against dark grey background (#12131A). Avoid dark grey text on dark panels.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, HUD items, buttons, inputs, towers, hero cards, and status elements MUST include data-testid (kebab-case, role-based). Examples: data-testid='hero-slot-1', data-testid='start-wave-button', data-testid='castle-hp-bar', data-testid='debug-toggle-panel'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Demonanic Living Game Design v140 document requirements.
Implement the full game loop: Login/Account -> Home/Start -> Preparation -> 5s Scout Countdown -> Active Wave (real-time canvas) -> Results -> Preparation.
Ensure portrait battlefield layout on canvas with enemies advancing TOP downward to 4 heroes lined up at the BOTTOM.
Ensure yellow glowing outer boundary walls (#FFE600) and hot-red inner gate line (#FF2A5F) on dark grey field (#12131A).
Provide interactive side config panels for Heroes (Helm, Armor, Weapon, Cloak, Ring, stats HP/ATK/DEF/AGL/INT) and Tower slot rack (1-5 slots with weapon/utility icons).
Hero/Tower profile cards should trigger a Tactical Battle Clock slowdown during active wave combat.
Include bottom HUD (Gold+Workers, Food+Farmers, Stone, Morale bar, Castle HP) and top/side Enemy HUD.
Add Debug/Developer panel and account Profile screen.
Attach data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for frontend automation tests.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or plain flat white backgrounds.
Use glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-md and neon borders (cyan/magenta/yellow).
Ensure interactive states (hover, active, focus) explicitly declare text color (e.g., hover:text-white hover:bg-cyan-500).
Avoid using Inter or Arial for main headings; use 'Unbounded' or 'Bebas Neue' or 'JetBrains Mono'.
Keep mobile image heights under max-h-[80vh].
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
